# Tubi

> Tubi is a free, ad-supported streaming service (FAST/AVOD) with thousands of movies, TV shows, and live channels. No subscription or credit card is required to watch.

Content on tubitv.com is publicly browsable, and each title has its own detail page with a description, cast, and ratings. Account pages, profile pages, and password-reset flows are not useful for indexing.

## Browse

- [Home](https://tubitv.com/): Featured and personalized rows
- [Movies](https://tubitv.com/movies): Free movies by genre
- [TV Shows](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows): Free series and episodes
- [Live TV](https://tubitv.com/live): Live news, sports, and entertainment channels
- [Networks](https://tubitv.com/networks): Content grouped by network and channel brand
- [Search](https://tubitv.com/search): Search titles, people, and genres

## Title pages

- Movie: `https://tubitv.com/movies/{id}/{title}`
- TV series: `https://tubitv.com/series/{id}/{title}`
- TV episode: `https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/{id}/{title}`
- Live channel: `https://tubitv.com/live/{id}/{title}`
- Category: `https://tubitv.com/category/{id}/{title}`

## Discovery

- [Sitemap index](https://tubitv.com/sitemap.xml): Full list of crawlable pages
- [Static pages sitemap](https://tubitv.com/sitemaps/static-pages.xml)
- [The T sitemap](https://tubitv.com/the-t/sitemaps/sitemap.xml): Tubi's editorial blog

## Optional

- [Terms of Use](https://tubitv.com/terms.html)
- [Privacy Policy](https://tubitv.com/privacy.html)
- [Help Center](https://tubitv.com/help-center)
